newsitem.title: CANADA: Fire reported in Toronto subway station.
newsitem.headline: Fire reported in Toronto subway station.

text.p: Between 60 and 100 people were evacuated from a Toronto subway station on Wednesday night after a fire sent smoke billowing through the building and adjoining subway tunnels, police said.

Toronto police said no one was seriously injured in the fire, which began at about 7.30 p.m. EDT (2330 GMT) in the Danforth and Donlands station, but several people appeared to have been overcome by smoke.
